_comment: Deployment record for the v2.1.1 OIV cross-chain infra (salt v2). Deployed EOA-owned, configured (mainnet selector registry seeded), then ownership transferred to the OIV Safe. The four `canonical` contracts share one address on every chain (deterministic CREATE2, salt v2, eoaOwner 0xAa5A...4F72). `chains[]` = the 19 deployed chains (FINAL set). `excluded[]` = chains deliberately not pursued (decision 2026-07-22). Salt v1 (factory 0xfb762083839AaED43Af0d37e67d7EE62340D25f0) is SUPERSEDED (was deployed with owner handed to the Safe at deploy time; redeployed at salt v2 to allow EOA config before handover). Human companion: docs/DEPLOYED_ADDRESSES.md. NOTE: `explorerVerified` = block-explorer SOURCE verification — now TRUE on all 19 (see `verification` block for verifier per chain).

canonical._comment: Same address on every chain (deterministic CREATE2, salt v2). owner()==finalOwner (Safe) post-handover.

chains.name: hyperevm
chains.note: required HyperEVM big blocks enabled for the deploy (disabled after). Added to the mainnet selector registry via an OIV Safe tx (script/safe-txs/hyperevm-selector.json).

excluded.name: bob
excluded.reason: EXCLUDED by decision 2026-07-22 (not pursued). Deployer unfunded; otherwise READY-AFTER-EMPTY.

excluded.name: katana
excluded.reason: EXCLUDED by decision 2026-07-22 (not pursued). Deployer unfunded; otherwise READY-AFTER-EMPTY.

addedAfterHandover.name: hyperevm
addedAfterHandover.via: OIV Safe tx on mainnet (setChainSelector) — see script/safe-txs/hyperevm-selector.json

verification.status: all 19 chains source-verified on their primary explorer (2026-07-22); multi-explorer coverage broadened 2026-07-23 (Blockscout + OKLink + Sourcify v2 + Routescan + Tenderly-public). Sourcify v2 is the widest: 3 main contracts exact-match on all 19 chains, auto-propagated to Etherscan/Routescan/Blockscout. Tenderly public covers the 3 main contracts on 18/19 (all but hyperevm).

etherscanV2._comment: Primary: all 3 main contracts + emptyContract (Empty filled 2026-07-23). Shared Etherscan V2 multichain key.

etherscanV2_dedicatedKey._comment: Shared key lacked Linea access; used a Linea-scoped Etherscan V2 key.

blockscout._comment: The 3 main contracts confirmed is_verified via /api/v2/smart-contracts on all listed instances; emptyContract also confirmed on ethereum/gnosis/arbitrum/celo/unichain/ink/worldchain (pending/failed on base/polygon/scroll). Added 2026-07-23 with a Blockscout Pro key.

notReached.optimism: optimism.blockscout.com rejected the standard-JSON submission (already covered by Etherscan V2 + OKLink)
notReached.hyperevm: www.hyperscan.com API reports the address as not-a-contract (incompatible endpoint)

oklink._comment: Keyless (no Ok-Access-Key needed) standard-JSON verify API. kpkOivFactory/kpkSharesDeployer/ccipOivDeployer confirmed Success. emptyContract not verifiable on OKLink (trivial-contract matcher quirk).

sourcify._comment: Verified via Sourcify v2 HTTP API (keyless, exact bytecode match from chain state — no constructor args). forge's --verifier sourcify only speaks the deprecated v1 API (in brownout 2026-07-07..2027-01-08), so POST v2 directly at https://sourcify.dev/server/v2/verify/{chainId}/{address}. Sourcify auto-propagates each match to etherscan + routescan + blockscout via externalVerifications. Added 2026-07-23.
sourcify.emptyNote: emptyContract not verifiable on Sourcify (bytecode_length_mismatch — trivial contract); covered on Etherscan V2 + Blockscout instead.

routescan._comment: Etherscan-compatible multichain explorer, keyless ('verifyContract' placeholder key). Coverage here was obtained automatically via Sourcify v2 externalVerifications propagation (3 main contracts). Direct forge path also works but hits the .env ETHERSCAN_API_KEY override.

tenderly._comment: PUBLIC verification (irreversible) via Tenderly's Etherscan-compatible API in the karpatkey/agents project. forge can't be used (its .env ETHERSCAN_API_KEY auto-load overrides the Tenderly verifier-url) — POST directly to https://api.tenderly.co/api/v1/account/{account}/project/{project}/etherscan/verify/network/{chainId}/public with X-Access-Key. Added 2026-07-23.

notReached.emptyContract: NOTOK on the trivial Empty contract (same quirk as Sourcify/OKLink) — covered on Etherscan V2 + Blockscout
